title: Letter to Voss
summary: Read to advance The Githyanki Warrior and learn where Voss planned to meet his contact.

fields.Read: Advances The Githyanki Warrior toward Raphael on the upper floor of Sharess’ Caress in Baldur’s Gate. The note can provide the lead if Voss became hostile.

changes: Added native BG3 quest and Inspiration uses verified against pinned item and quest revisions. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
